description:
intent=i019 snapshot=s03 branch=free-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c:437-447 confidence=low conclusion=send_pkt() stores skb into long-lived chan->data (net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c:447) that bt_xmit/send_mcast_pkt free via dev_kfree_skb at :549 / kfree_skb at :501, leaving a dangling stored skb pointer with no in-tree reader - a latent stored-pointer UAF, low confidence.
unresolved location=drivers/net/arcnet/rfc1201.c:348 conclusion=Follow up: read drivers/net/arcnet/rfc1201.c rx() lines 340-395 fully to check whether pkt->hard.source (or any pkt/soft deref) executes after netif_rx(skb) at :383 when debug printing (BUGLVL) is enabled, and whether in->skb can alias the handed-off skb.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/qualcomm/rmnet/rmnet_map_command.c:15 conclusion=Follow up: read rmnet_map_command.c lines 10-70 to confirm the kfree_skb(skb) at :23 is on a return-only error path so that map_header+1 at :63 never dereferences freed data, or to record it as a finding if any path falls through.
coverage_gap=The primary enumerator was a single-function 60-line sliding-window scan (515 save-free-use triples) over net/ and drivers/net/; free/use pairs farther apart, in separate functions, or via helper-called frees were not systematically found.
coverage_gap=drivers/net/ beyond the directories sampled in the hit list (ethernet, wireless, wan, can, usb, arcnet, fddi, ppp) and non-net trees (fs/, other drivers/) were not audited; ~4756 free-call sites exist in the scanned trees alone.
coverage_gap=Pattern-2 sites storing skb->data-derived pointers (not the skb pointer itself) into long-lived state - driver private structs, firmware command structs, timers, work items - were not enumerated; only chan->data in net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c was followed end-to-end.
coverage_gap=pskb_may_pull/pskb_pull/pskb_expand_head/skb_cow head-reallocation stale-pointer sites were deliberately excluded per branch instructions (facts i004/i009/i014 cover s03 pull/expand variants).
limitation=The single finding is a stored dangling pointer with no demonstrated dereference in s03: chan->data is written at net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c:447 but every chan->data reader in net/bluetooth/ belongs to l2cap_sock.c socket channels, so no crash or disclosure is proven (low confidence).
limitation=No build, KASAN run, or reproducer was performed (read-only snapshot, no network); every conclusion rests on static reading of s03's exact lines.
limitation=The scanner's derivation regex (var = ... skb->data ...) misses multi-line derivations, pointers passed through helper functions, and skb->cb/skb_shinfo/frag-page based derivations, so false negatives among the 4756 free sites cannot be excluded.
limitation=The seed net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (lines 45-67, present and unpatched in s03) was excluded per assignment rules, as were pull-induced head-reallocation variants (other branches).
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque; line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s03 as supplied and no git history exists to check upstream fix status.
